SMB repeat complaint for 4-day late delivery; customer explicitly references competitor's 2-day express as comparison, indicating SLA miss triggered complaint.
Operations team confirms complaint volume climbing with late delivery as primary reason; WH-07 backlog of 1,900 orders directly correlates to SLA breach complaints.
Enterprise customer QBR failure attributed to June delivery misses on 4 POs; SLA failures linked to renewal risk and complaint escalation.
WH-07 conveyor failure on June 25 reduced sortation to 60% throughput with staffing shortfall of 14 pickers; operations explicitly forecasted SLA breaches on North-West lanes as direct consequence.
